purpose: Traceable proof for every claim in the PASS 31 matrices and final report.

modules.validation: ownerCockpitExplanationSchema (Zod): top-action-needs-reason, owner-gated-needs-reason, evidence-route-needs-evidence, high-risk-needs-blocked, no PII/injection/currency in owner-facing strings
modules.input: PublicSignalPrioritisation (PASS 30) — re-derives nothing from raw text; +2 cluster summary fields (sourceQualitySummary/evidenceStrengthSummary) added to IssueClusterView
modules.authority: explains only; the governed bridge remains the routing/owner-gating/evidence-gating authority

claims.claim: Prioritised output creates a top action + a schema-valid explanation
States why top outranks secondaries (incl. growth)
Evidence required before completion is present
Blocked unsafe actions visible; tender auto-submit blocked
One top explanation + grouped bounded secondaries
No raw-signal / PII / injection text in explanation or tasks
No fabricated money/ROI/win-probability in owner-facing fields
Monitor-only-positive and clean workspaces fabricate no explanation
No hidden score; weak evidence never stated as fact

honestGaps: The explanation layer is deterministic/rule-based; it explains upstream governed outputs, not a learned/opaque model.
Owner-facing copy is templated from governed fields; it is not natural-language generation.
Live connectors / crawling / LLM understanding / private owner shadow pilot remain out of scope (frozen — see DEFERRED_BROAD_GAPS.md).
